title: Fight camera · moving it with the right stick
description: In a fight either player's right stick moves the camera round the fight (up to 45° either side, 15° up or down) and it stays where it was left; pressing the stick in (R3) brings it back (src/game.ts `rightStick`). The pads are fake standard pads set from the page.

steps.eval: window.stick = (x, y, r3 = false, second = false) => { const make = (ax, ay, click) => ({ connected: true, mapping: 'standard', id: 'fake', axes: [0, 0, ax, ay], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => ({ pressed: i === 10 && click, value: 0 })) }); navigator.getGamepads = () => second ? [make(0, 0, false), make(x, y, r3)] : [make(x, y, r3)]; }; stick(0, 0)

steps.caption: Stick right, then let go: the camera has swung round and stays there
Player 2's stick moves the same camera: up lowers it, and it stays
R3 (pressing the stick in): back to the fight's own angle
